headline: Treasury yields face 4.8% test
detail: Rising Treasury yields can put pressure on growth stocks, especially those in the tech and chip sectors that you are concentrated in. This could lead to further drawdowns in your leveraged positions.

headline: Oil prices hit near seven-week highs
detail: Higher oil prices can signal inflationary pressures, which might influence Federal Reserve policy and indirectly impact tech valuations. It also adds to broader market uncertainty.

headline: China just pumped $54 billion into banks and insurers — but their stocks still fell
detail: This suggests underlying weakness in the Chinese economy, which can have ripple effects on global markets and supply chains relevant to the semiconductor industry.

headline: Jaguar Land Rover to layoff thousands of jobs
detail: This indicates potential economic slowdown in the automotive sector, which could indirectly affect demand for chips used in vehicles.
